subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should this feature request close as satisfied by current Sessions-page `Group by: Channel` plus `Group by: None`, or remain open for true separated channel conversation tabs and a merged all-channel transcript timeline?
rationale: Current main implements channel grouping of session rows, but the issue asks for conversation view modes and an all-channel timeline, so automation cannot safely choose the acceptance boundary.

options.title: Close As Grouping Sufficient
options.body: Treat current Sessions-page channel grouping and ungrouped modes as satisfying the central monitoring use case without adding transcript merging.

options.title: Keep For Timeline Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define separated channel tabs, merged transcript ordering, privacy, and reply routing semantics.

options.title: Fold Into Workspace Issue
options.body: Move the remaining timeline design under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if the broader sessions workspace should own it.

recommendation.title: Keep For Timeline Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers define separated channel tabs, merged transcript ordering, privacy, and reply routing semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main implementation and merge provenance is steipete's Control UI session grouping work.
